levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عمر بن ميسرة

notes: The Marwan and Ibn Umar exchange after the saying is the scene told by Abu Hurayra; Marwan and Ibn Umar speak in it and are not links (rule 6).
«قال عبيد الله في حديثه قال لا» is a wording remark by a transmitter already in the chain; left out.
«- ... -» is not used here; the ending «ما ذنبي إن كنت حفظت» is Abu Hurayra's own words.
